title: Telemetry Uplink Payload Schema
description: JSON Schema for ingest_telemetry RPC uplink payload transmitted periodically by IoT nodes.

p_device_id.description: Unique UUID identifier of the IoT device.

p_device_key.description: Secret authentication key of the IoT device.

p_telemetry_data.description: Arbitrary key-value map representing current sensor values, actuator states, and diagnostics.
